3-DAY NOTICE TO PAY RENT OR QUIT
Date: November 1, 2022
To:
John Doe
7890 Ocean Side Lane, Apt. 15
Los Angeles, CA 90001
From:
Sunset Properties, Inc.
2500 Sunset Blvd, Suite 500
Los Angeles, CA 90026
(213) 555-1234

YOU ARE HEREBY NOTIFIED that you are in default in the payment of rent for the premises described above. The total amount of rent due and unpaid is:
$2,500.00

This amount represents rent due for the month of October 2022, including applicable late fees as permitted under your rental agreement.

WITHIN THREE (3) BUSINESS DAYS, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and judicial holidays, after service of this notice, you must either:

1. PAY the total amount of rent stated above, OR
2. QUIT AND DELIVER UP POSSESSION of the premises to the undersigned.

Payment must be made by personal check, or deposited directly into the account of Sunset Properties, Inc. at City Bank, 5000 Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90027, Account No. 1234567890. Payments at the bank must be made within five miles of your rental property. Electronic payment is also allowed as it was previously established.

Payment hours are from Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

FAILURE TO COMPLY with this notice within the time stated will result in the initiation of legal proceedings to recover possession of the premises, forfeiture of the rental agreement, and the filing of an unlawful detainer (eviction) action against you.

Landlord / Agent Signature:
Property Manager, Sunset Properties, Inc.
